subject: AuroraHealth SOC2: IAM artifact intake & workback
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@aurorahealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: security@aurorahealth.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0500
Subject: IAM artifact request for SOC2 / SIG review

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for taking this. Aurora Health is finalizing our vendor SIG/SOC2 checklist and we need a curated set of IAM artifacts that demonstrate your SSO/SCIM provisioning, RBAC controls, and least-privilege enforcement. Our reviewers typically ask for the following:

- A couple of redacted SAML assertion samples (production-like) showing attributes and audience values.
- A sample SCIM delta export (recent 7–14 days) showing create/update/delete events.
- A role-to-owner matrix that maps roles to human owners and approval owners.
- A short description (1–2 pages) of how you enforce least privilege for service accounts and cross-tenant access.

If possible, please provide an internal point of contact and a recommended upload mechanism (secure S3 presigned link, ShareFile, or our DocuSign/secure portal). We have a target to complete evidence intake by 2026-11-30 to keep our audit timeline.

Also note: our team prefers artifacts with minimal sensitive PII — redaction is fine; call out what was redacted.

Appreciate it,
Nina Patel
Sr. Vendor Risk Analyst
Aurora Health — InfoSec

--
Attachment(s): none in this email (request only)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com

Nina —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you asked for. Quick plan to stay on the audit timeline:

1) Today (22 Nov): internal kickoff and artifact compilation (aditya, grace, marissa).
2) 23 Nov: deliver a redactioned SAML assertion packet + role matrix and SCIM delta sample for your intake portal.
3) 25 Nov: follow-up Q&A and a brief runbook describing our least-privilege enforcement for service accounts.

Preferred upload method: we can provide a presigned S3 upload link (expires in 48 hrs) and also mirror artifacts to your secure Drive folder if you prefer. Please confirm which you want.

I copied Grace (IAM) and Marissa (Customer Success) for timeline and context. We will mark anything redacted in each artifact and include a short manifest describing fields removed.

Are there any specific attribute names or SCIM event fields your reviewers expect (e.g., urn:oid:... attributes, or particular custom claims)? If not, we will include the common set and flag the claim map.

Best,
Aditya Rao

Redwood Inference

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, Nina Patel <nina.patel@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: IAM artifact request for SOC2 / SIG review

Aditya / Nina —

Looping in the IAM artifact set. I've collected samples from the production staging bucket, redacted PII, and prepared a short runbook. Contents attached below and summarized here:

- saml-assertion-samples.txt (attached): two redacted assertion examples (login and attribute-sync). Redacted: NameID, user email; kept subject, audience, authninstant, and all claim keys.
- scim-delta-sample.csv (attached): 14-day delta with event_type (create/update/delete), external_id, timestamp, actor_id (redacted), and patch summary.
- role-ownership-matrix.xlsx (attached): maps 120 internal roles -> owner email aliases (roles marked as service accounts are in the last tab).
- iam-evidence-runbook.pdf (attached): 2-page narrative describing our provisioning flow (SCIM source of truth: Okta), how we enforce RBAC at application layer, our service-account rotation cadence, and where logs are retained for 90 days.

Notes / callouts:
- SCIM deltas are exported from the provisioning service at 00:00 UTC daily. The sample contains masked actor IDs; we can provide a separate mapping under NDA if your reviewers require identity correlation.
- Least-privilege: we enforce role scoping with environment tags, and use approval workflows for role elevation (built into our internal IAM portal). The runbook includes the approval run screenshots (redacted).
- Auditability: SAML assertions and SCIM events are correlated to request IDs; we included request_id in both sample sets to demonstrate linkage.

I'll upload the artifacts to a presigned S3 URL once Nina confirms. If Aurora prefers the Drive path, we will mirror there as well.

Grace O'Connor
Staff IAM Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment(s): saml-assertion-samples.txt (text/plain), scim-delta-sample.csv (text/csv), role-ownership-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), iam-evidence-runbook.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@aurorahealth.com>

Aditya / Grace —

This looks good, thank you. Presigned S3 upload is fine; please send the link when ready and we will ingest artifacts into our secure portal. Two small follow-ups:

1) For the SCIM delta, please include a brief note that explains how you calculate "delta" (lastSync marker, cursor) so our intake team knows whether it's incremental or full snapshot.
2) For the role matrix, can you flag roles that are considered "privileged" for our reviewers (separate column)? That makes triage quicker.

If you can get the upload link over today or tomorrow morning PST, we will aim to complete intake by 11/30. We may ask a short list of clarifying questions after review — expecting that to be quick.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
